patch.value:
Four repository scripts make their own exit decision after generating Markdown. Once the package fix for #384 is released, an update of the package alone will still leave these scripts failing on changes confined to Unreleased.

| Consumer | Where the wrapper decides |
| --- | --- |
| pm-ops | [runChangelog](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-ops/blob/e5fe89d6d430391fabaa95ba5c372e82f5caea77/scripts/pm-changelog.ts#L43-L53) normalizes empty release text, then compares the entire result to the destination. |
| pm-slack | [releaseChangelog](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-slack/blob/90aadf3dd593e61a71fa712d280491927fcde5bf/scripts/pm-changelog.ts#L14-L25) removes the check flag, asks for stdout, and compares the entire file. |
| pm-gantt-chart | [projectChangelog](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-gantt-chart/blob/b7dd62f9a76d2e7014a6b29c6c03d7284456730f/scripts/pm-changelog.ts#L33-L46) removes an empty placeholder and compares all remaining bytes. |
| pm-review | [runChangelog](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/blob/379abddc4162c3ad01fb638b8be235aaa7deb250/scripts/changelog.ts#L52-L58) calls the package checker on a mismatch, then returns 1 regardless of that check's exit code. |

After the package release, exercise each wrapper with its normal generation flags in its own repository. Verify pending-only changes succeed read-only, strict checks still fail, and versioned drift still fails. Preserve each wrapper's link validation, project-specific rendering, summary output, and release preparation contract. This follow-up tracks the four independent exit decisions. Direct callers of the package checker receive the new default through their dependency update.
Track downstream wrappers that independently compare the entire changelog
